title: Travel cities
blurb: The must-sees, must-eats and neighbourhoods of the cities people talk about travelling to.

groups.name: Asia & Pacific
groups.intro: The weekend trips and big-holiday cities from Hong Kong.

items.name: Tokyo
items.what: Huge, safe and spotless, mixing neon and calm shrines.

facts.v: Shibuya Crossing, Senso-ji, Meiji Shrine, teamLab, Tokyo Skytree
Sushi at Toyosu, ramen, izakaya yakitori, depachika food halls
Shibuya, Shinjuku, Ginza, Asakusa, Shimokitazawa

items.name: Kyoto
items.what: Japan's old imperial capital of temples and geisha districts.

facts.v: Fushimi Inari's red gates, Kinkaku-ji, Arashiyama bamboo grove
Kaiseki, matcha sweets, Nishiki Market
Gion, Higashiyama, Arashiyama

items.name: Osaka
items.what: Japan's loud, fun 'kitchen of the nation'.

facts.v: Dotonbori, Osaka Castle, Universal Studios Japan
Takoyaki, okonomiyaki, kushikatsu
Namba, Umeda, Shinsekai

items.name: Seoul
items.what: Fast, trendy and open late, from palaces to K-beauty.

facts.v: Gyeongbokgung Palace, Bukchon Hanok Village, N Seoul Tower
Korean BBQ, fried chicken and beer, Gwangjang Market
Myeongdong, Hongdae, Gangnam, Seongsu

items.name: Taipei
items.what: Friendly, easy and all about food.

facts.v: Taipei 101, National Palace Museum, Jiufen day trip
Night markets, beef noodles, xiaolongbao at Din Tai Fung
Ximending, Da'an, Xinyi

items.name: Bangkok
items.what: Chaotic, hot, cheap and full of temples.

facts.v: Grand Palace, Wat Arun, Chatuchak Weekend Market
Street food, pad thai, mango sticky rice, rooftop bars
Sukhumvit, Silom, Chinatown (Yaowarat)

items.name: Singapore
items.what: Clean, green and efficient city-state.

facts.v: Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands, Sentosa
Hawker centres: chicken rice, laksa, chilli crab
Marina Bay, Chinatown, Tiong Bahru, Kampong Glam

items.name: Shanghai
items.what: China's glossy financial capital with colonial-era charm.

facts.v: The Bund, Lujiazui skyline, Yu Garden
Xiaolongbao, shengjianbao, hairy crab in autumn
Former French Concession, Jing'an, Xintiandi

items.name: Sydney
items.what: Harbour city of beaches and outdoor living.

facts.v: Opera House, Harbour Bridge, Bondi to Coogee walk
Brunch, flat whites, fresh seafood
The Rocks, Surry Hills, Bondi, Manly

items.name: Paris
items.what: Cafés, museums and boulevards.

facts.v: Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Musée d'Orsay, Montmartre
Croissants, bistros, steak frites, macarons
Le Marais, Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Montmartre

items.name: London
items.what: Museums (mostly free), pubs and royal sights.

facts.v: British Museum, Tower of London, Westminster, Tate Modern
Sunday roast, Borough Market, curry on Brick Lane
Soho, Shoreditch, Notting Hill, South Bank

items.name: Rome
items.what: Ancient ruins on every corner.

facts.v: Colosseum, Pantheon, Vatican and Sistine Chapel, Trevi Fountain
Carbonara, cacio e pepe, supplì, gelato
Trastevere, Monti, Centro Storico

items.name: Barcelona
items.what: Gaudí, beaches and late nights.

facts.v: Sagrada Família, Park Güell, La Rambla, Casa Batlló
Tapas, paella, cava
Gothic Quarter, El Born, Gràcia

items.name: Amsterdam
items.what: Canals, bikes and Dutch masters.

facts.v: Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank House
Stroopwafels, Dutch fries, herring
Jordaan, De Pijp, canal belt

items.name: Lisbon
items.what: Hilly, sunny and tiled.

facts.v: Belém Tower, Tram 28, Alfama viewpoints
Pastel de nata, grilled sardines, bifana
Alfama, Bairro Alto, Chiado

items.name: Istanbul
items.what: Where Europe meets Asia across the Bosphorus.

facts.v: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Bosphorus cruise
Kebabs, baklava, Turkish breakfast
Sultanahmet, Beyoğlu, Karaköy, Kadıköy

groups.name: Americas
groups.intro: The big North and South American trips.

items.name: New York
items.what: The city that never sleeps.

facts.v: Central Park, Times Square, Met Museum, Statue of Liberty
Pizza slices, bagels, pastrami at Katz's
Manhattan's SoHo and West Village, Brooklyn

items.name: Los Angeles
items.what: Sprawling, sunny and car-dependent.

facts.v: Hollywood, Santa Monica, Getty Center, Griffith Observatory
Tacos, Korean BBQ in Koreatown, In-N-Out
Venice, Silver Lake, Beverly Hills

items.name: San Francisco
items.what: Hilly, foggy tech city on the bay.

facts.v: Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, cable cars
Sourdough, clam chowder, Mission burritos
Mission, Chinatown, North Beach

items.name: Mexico City
items.what: Huge, artsy and one of the world's best food cities.

facts.v: Zócalo, Frida Kahlo Museum, Teotihuacán pyramids
Tacos al pastor, street food, mezcal
Roma, Condesa, Coyoacán

items.name: Dubai
items.what: Record-breaking towers, malls and desert.

facts.v: Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, desert safari, Palm Jumeirah
Shawarma, Emirati dishes, lavish brunches
Downtown, Dubai Marina, Al Fahidi

items.name: Marrakech
items.what: Red-walled city of souks and riads.

facts.v: Jemaa el-Fnaa square, Majorelle Garden, the souks
Tagine, couscous, mint tea
The Medina, Gueliz

items.name: Cape Town
items.what: Mountains, ocean and wine country together.

facts.v: Table Mountain, Cape of Good Hope, Robben Island
Braai, seafood, Stellenbosch wine
V&A Waterfront, Bo-Kaap, Camps Bay
